checks: URL panel=studio mounts the real editing desk at the Jarvis station, uses the new 22.7 s film and loads its stylesheet without automatic playback.
The global Studio action reopens a fresh controller; closing pauses the previous player and removes its media and export listeners.
Switching from Studio to the historical identity or project scenario releases the previous Studio instead of keeping a hidden active player.
Native dialog close disposes Studio; a queued close from the preceding dialog does not destroy an immediate reopening.
Global and operating-system reduced motion reach the mounted Studio, pause the film and never restart playback when motion is re-enabled.
The real Studio form exports one parseable local JSON plan with the selected 16:9 / 30 s target and truthful plan-only, unrendered and unpublished status.

Sending the reference film from Studio closes/disposes the desk, revokes its export URL and receives a right-screen acknowledgement while Jarvis and the left screen keep their roles; no render, publication or automatic playback is triggered.
The integration completes with unique central-page IDs and no JavaScript error.
displayTransport: real protocol over isolated BroadcastChannel fixture
scope: Targeted application/Studio integration; chapter timing, crop math and visual rendering belong to separate module/media verification.
